# <browser-window>

Safari-style browser window frame for demos and tutorials. A separate package, @profpowell/browser-window, not part of the Vanilla Breeze bundle: load it yourself. Docs: https://profpowell.github.io/browser-window/

- Web component from a separate package. Not in the Vanilla Breeze bundle; load its own script.
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string |  |  |
| `url` | string |  |  |
| `title` | string |  |  |
| `shadow` | boolean |  |  |
